title: AI Transformation with Microsoft Copilot
tagline: Lead business outcomes with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Workflows and Agents
hook: Put Copilot to work across everyday tasks, repeatable workflows and focused agents
marketing_pitch: For C-suite and senior leaders: use Microsoft 365 Copilot to improve real work, design a no-code Copilot Workflow, build and test a focused Copilot agent, and decide what to scale using measurable outcomes and human controls.
description: A three-day WSQ course for executives and senior managers. Participants use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook and Teams for everyday business work; design and test Copilot Workflows with approval and exception paths; and create, test and share a bounded agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder. A synthetic case supports pilot planning, adoption, quality, value and board decisions. Workflows and agent availability vary by tenant; equivalent offline design and testing are provided. The course draws on Microsoft AB-730 business use and AB-731 transformation leadership. It is not exam preparation and requires no coding.
learning_outcomes: Develop technology implementation plans and business processes for Microsoft Copilot.
Develop control procedures for Microsoft Copilot to manage security.
Evaluate the integration of Microsoft Copilot to ensure alignment with business objectives.
Develop optimization plans for Microsoft Copilot to improve business operations.

topics.title: Use Microsoft 365 Copilot for everyday business work
Design safe Copilot Workflows and human controls
Create and test bounded Copilot agents
Lead adoption, measure value and scale outcomes

mode: Physical classroom or synchronised Zoom; corporate training available
venue: 12 Woodlands Square #07-85/86/87, Woods Square Tower 1, Singapore 737715
assessment: Written assessment and practical performance assessment, one hour each, individual open book
who_should_attend: C-suite executives, business unit leaders, directors and senior managers who sponsor or govern Microsoft Copilot adoption.
certification: Certificate of Achievement from Tertiary Infotech Academy and, on meeting WSQ assessment and attendance requirements, SkillsFuture Singapore Statement of Attainment via OpenCerts.
